The edit form reuses the create form, with existing values pre-filled. The backend validates each update, and the frontend reports the outcome of every update to the user.","business_value":"Tasks stay accurate over time, so users can keep their personal to-do list current without deleting and recreating tasks.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"The user opens the edit form, changes the title to a non-empty value of 100 characters or fewer, and submits the form","then":"The backend stores the new title and returns success, and the task shows the new title in the list"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update with a missing mandatory field error, the stored title is unchanged, and the message \"Title is mandatory\" is shown"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user enters a title of 101 characters and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating the 100-character limit is shown"},{"given":"An existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"The user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns an error","when":"The frontend receives the error response","then":"The frontend does not show the task as updated, keeps the form values for correction, and displays an error message"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns success","when":"The frontend receives the success response","then":"The frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"A task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"An update request is sent for that ID","then":"The backend returns a Task Not Found error and no data is changed"},{"given":"An update request with a malformed body or a field of the wrong type","when":"The backend receives the request","then":"The backend returns an invalid input error and no data is changed"},{"given":"An update request where the database fails during the write","when":"The backend processes the request","then":"The backend only dates earlier than the Creation Date.","A title of exactly 100 characters is accepted; a title of 101 characters is rejected.","Open question: a title made only of spaces may be treated as empty; the PRD does not say whether whitespace is trimmed.","Open question: the PRD does not say whether the Creation Date can be changed through the edit form. Return Task Not Found for unknown IDs, invalid input and missing mandatory field errors for bad requests, and an internal server error for database failures. Do not change data when validation or lookup fails.
